packageRules.description: Security-first posture: suppress all routine (non-security) version updates. vulnerabilityAlerts force-overrides this for vulnerable deps, so security PRs still open.
Re-enable end-of-life / end-of-support PRs (endoflife-date datasource). Auto-detected, no annotation needed; tolerant of false positives.

customManagers.description: Terraform CLI pin (hashicorp/setup-terraform terraform_version input) -> endoflife-date

RDS/Aurora Postgres engine_version -> endoflife-date. Recursive: the outer regex isolates the `rds_master = { ... }` block (bounded by its own closing brace), the inner regex finds engine_version within just that block, so only that line is ever rewritten and a sibling Redis engine_version can't be matched.

ElastiCache Redis engine_version -> endoflife-date. Recursive, same as the Postgres manager above but scoped to a `redis = { ... }` block; depName is amazon-elasticache-redis (verified on endoflife.date), NOT the community `redis` slug, since ElastiCache's supported versions (currently 7.x) lag community Redis (already 8.x).
